cm1_research_objectives.reason: The study explicitly states its objectives: to investigate deviations in subcortical volumes in MS patients using deep learning and normative modeling, and to comparing segmentations based on both T1w and FLAIR images.
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text: This study harnesses cutting-edge neuroimaging and deep learning techniques to investigate deviations in subcortical volumes in MS patients... By comparing subcortical volumes of 326 MS patients to a normative model from 37,407 healthy individuals, we identify significant deviations that enhance our understanding of MS progression.
